svg.aria-label: Seats and gates. I set intent and make the final call. A frontier model in the lead seat plans, briefs and reviews; it sends full briefs to scoped builders, two at a time, and fans reads out to cheaper models. Builds pass deterministic checks, then a refute-first reviewer with at most six hand-aimed mutants; a surviving mutant goes back to the builders with one test. A human gate on push, publish, send and spend closes only on my yes. Then ship, verify the live effect, and remember: lessons become scripts, CLAUDE.md lines, skills or memory, and the next session starts with verified context.
svg.text: a full brief: files, constraints, and why
a surviving mutant gets one test
verified context for the next session
high-stakes claims: a second lab's model
Note: a hook enforces the seats. It denies an unpinned general-purpose subagent and a third concurrent Opus agent.
